verdict.rationale: Clerk docs explicitly list authenticator-app TOTP and backup codes as second-factor MFA strategies, and describe a needs_second_factor sign-in status that blocks completion until the second factor is provided, giving basic step-up-style enforcement at sign-in. However, there is no evidence of a dedicated step-up/reverification mechanism for sensitive in-app actions (beyond initial sign-in), and community comments note MFA becomes costly on paid tiers, suggesting real-world friction. Missing for 10: documented step-up/reverification API for gating sensitive actions post-login, independent hands-on confirmation of TOTP/backup-code UX working reliably.
